vocabulary.meaning_en: a prize for doing something well
vocabulary.example: Our company won an award for design.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a short talk you give when you receive a prize
vocabulary.example: Keep your acceptance speech short.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a polite way to start speaking to an audience
vocabulary.example: Ladies and gentlemen, welcome to our event.

vocabulary.meaning_en: representing someone or a group
vocabulary.example: On behalf of the team, thank you.

vocabulary.meaning_en: in the leading position in an area
vocabulary.example: Our company is at the forefront of new technology.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a new idea, method or product
vocabulary.example: The award is for innovation in design.

vocabulary.meaning_en: something that increases confidence or success
vocabulary.example: The award was a real boost for the team.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to be very important to someone
vocabulary.example: Your support means a lot to us.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to be proud of a quality you have
vocabulary.example: We pride ourselves on our customer service.

vocabulary.meaning_en: the people who watch or listen to a speech or show
vocabulary.example: The audience clapped after her speech.

vocabulary.meaning_en: speaking in front of a group of people
vocabulary.example: Public speaking makes many people nervous.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a formal public event
vocabulary.example: The award ceremony was in a big hotel.

vocabulary.meaning_en: the best or most exciting part
vocabulary.example: The highlight of the day was the award.

vocabulary.meaning_en: without waiting any longer (said before announcing something)
vocabulary.example: Without further ado, here is our winner.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to tell people something officially
vocabulary.example: They will announce the winner at eight.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to start selling a new product
vocabulary.example: We'll be launching a new product soon.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to find something very difficult
vocabulary.example: I'm struggling to write this report.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a prize for the best worker of the year
vocabulary.example: She was named Employee of the Year.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to officially show that someone's work is good
vocabulary.example: The prize recognises her hard work.

vocabulary.meaning_en: something good you succeed in doing
vocabulary.example: Finishing the project early was a big achievement.

vocabulary.meaning_en: what you give or do to help something succeed
vocabulary.example: Thank you for your contribution to the project.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to have earned something because of your actions
vocabulary.example: You worked hard – you deserve this prize.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a person learning a job by working
vocabulary.example: He started as an apprentice and is now a manager.

vocabulary.meaning_en: working as part of the team
vocabulary.example: It's great to have you on board.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to solve a problem when things are going wrong
vocabulary.example: Anna saved the day by giving the speech.

fine_lines.title: on behalf of vs instead of
fine_lines.explanation_ar: on behalf of تعني أنك تمثل شخصًا أو مجموعة وتتكلم باسمهم. instead of تعني بدلًا من، أي أن شيئًا يحل محل شيء آخر.
fine_lines.explanation_en: 'On behalf of' means representing someone. 'Instead of' means in place of something else.

examples.sentence: On behalf of everyone here, thank you.
I had tea instead of coffee.

fine_lines.title: award vs reward
fine_lines.explanation_ar: award جائزة تُمنح رسميًا في حفل أو مسابقة. reward مكافأة تحصل عليها مقابل عمل جيد أو مساعدة، وليس بالضرورة في حفل.
fine_lines.explanation_en: An award is an official prize, often at a ceremony. A reward is something you get for good work or help.

examples.sentence: She won the Employee of the Year award.
The bonus is a reward for your hard work.

expressions.phrase: Ladies and gentlemen, on behalf of everyone at Tip Top Trading, thank you for our award.
expressions.meaning_ar: سيداتي وسادتي، نيابةً عن جميع العاملين في تيب توب تريدينغ، شكرًا لكم على هذه الجائزة.
expressions.meaning_en: A formal way to thank people for a prize for your company.
expressions.example: Ladies and gentlemen, on behalf of everyone at our school, thank you for this award.

expressions.phrase: Our company is at the forefront of plastic innovation.
expressions.meaning_ar: شركتنا في طليعة الابتكار في مجال البلاستيك.
expressions.meaning_en: Our company leads in new ideas.
expressions.example: Our company is at the forefront of green energy.

expressions.phrase: This award is a real boost for everyone working at the company.
expressions.meaning_ar: هذه الجائزة دفعة حقيقية لكل العاملين في الشركة.
expressions.meaning_en: The prize makes all the staff feel encouraged.
expressions.example: This award is a real boost for our small team.

expressions.phrase: This award really means a lot to us.
expressions.meaning_ar: هذه الجائزة تعني لنا الكثير حقًا.
expressions.meaning_en: The prize is very important to us.
expressions.example: Thank you all. This award really means a lot to us.

expressions.phrase: We pride ourselves on innovation and quality.
expressions.meaning_en: We are proud of our new ideas and good products.
expressions.example: We pride ourselves on fast delivery.
Ladies and gentlemen, please take your seats; the ceremony is starting.

expressions.meaning_en: You earned it by your work.
expressions.example: Congratulations on the prize – you deserve it.

expressions.phrase: It's great to have her on board.
expressions.meaning_ar: من الرائع أن تكون معنا في الفريق.
expressions.meaning_en: We're happy she's part of our team.
expressions.example: Welcome, Ali. It's great to have you on board.

grammar.title: Formal thanks: thank you for + noun / -ing
grammar.explanation_ar: بعد thank you for نضع اسمًا أو فعلًا بصيغة ing: thank you for our award / thank you for coming.
grammar.explanation_en: After 'thank you for' use a noun or a verb + -ing.
examples: Thank you for attending this year's conference.

grammar.title: Future continuous: will be + -ing
grammar.explanation_ar: will be + فعل بـ ing يُستخدم لإعلان خطط مستقبلية مؤكدة بطريقة رسمية: we'll be launching a new product.
grammar.explanation_en: Use will be + -ing to announce planned future actions formally.
examples: Coming soon, we'll be launching a new plastic aubergine.
We will be opening a new office next year.
I'll be visiting the factory on Monday.

grammar.title: Present perfect for news and achievements
grammar.explanation_ar: نستخدم have + التصريف الثالث لإعلان خبر جديد: We've actually won! / She has risen from an apprentice to a champion.
grammar.explanation_en: Use the present perfect to announce new results and achievements.
examples: She has risen from an apprentice to a champion.
Our team has finished the project.

questions.question: How should you start a formal speech?
questions.explanation_en: 'Ladies and gentlemen' is a formal opening.

questions.question: ___ everyone at Tip Top Trading, thank you for our award.
Our company is at the ___ of plastic innovation.
questions.explanation_ar: التعبير الصحيح: at the forefront of.
questions.explanation_en: The phrase is 'at the forefront of'.

questions.question: 'This award is a real boost' means the award ___.
Thank you for ___ this year's conference.
Coming soon, we ___ a new product.
What does 'without further ado' mean?
questions.explanation_en: It means without waiting any more.

questions.question: Which word means 'a new idea, method or product'?
questions.explanation_en: Innovation is a new idea or product.

questions.question: Anna won Employee of the Year. Paul says: 'You ___ it.'
Choose the correct sentence.
choices: This award really means a lot to us.
This award really mean a lot to us.
This award really means a lot for to us.
This award really meaning a lot to us.
questions.explanation_ar: award مفرد فنقول means، والتعبير mean a lot to.
questions.explanation_en: Singular subject: means; phrase: mean a lot to.
